key.label: API key
key.hint: Sent once to Keychain. Daminus never shows it again.

baseUrl.label: Base URL
baseUrl.hint: https, or http to this Mac only. Empty uses {default}.
baseUrl.hintNone: https, or http to this Mac only.
baseUrl.scheme: Use https. Plain http is allowed only for localhost, 127.0.0.1 or [::1].
baseUrl.invalid: That is not a web address.
baseUrl.credentials: Remove the user name and password from the address.

model.label: Model
model.manual: The list could not be read. Type the model name.

test.idle: Sends one short message: “reply with ok”. About 20 tokens.

privacy.title: What leaves this Mac
privacy.maskKeysDesc: sk-, ghp_, AKIA, xox, PEM and long random strings. Always on.
privacy.neverUrl: Anything from the exposed-URL check body
privacy.needScan: Run a scan first to see what would be sent.

aiClaudeCode.name: Claude Code
aiClaudeCode.sub: uses the Claude Code app already on this Mac · no API key
aiClaudeCode.readsValue: nothing in ~/.claude; no token is ever opened
aiClaudeCode.modelDesc: Passed to Claude Code; your plan decides what is available.
aiClaudeCode.howNote: Headless mode of the official CLI; same redacted payload and answer schema as any provider.

test.counted: Counted in your plan’s usage, not billed per token.

warning.title: Experimental: uses your Claude subscription
warning.body: Daminus hands the redacted payload to the Claude Code app you already use. Anthropic’s rules for subscriptions outside Claude Code and Claude.ai change often and may not allow this. Usage counts against your plan. If in doubt, use an API key.

cannot.title: When it can’t be used
cannot.notFoundBody: Install it from Anthropic, then Check again.
cannot.notSignedInBody: Run claude in Terminal and log in; Daminus never signs in.
cannot.limitBody: Stops with “limit hit”; switch provider or wait for the reset.
